items.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022
items.q: I think Donald Trump introduced such an attitude of authoritarianism

ctx.x: Yes. About this time and this —

I think they will say that this is a time when fascism took serious hold in the United States. I think that there is a protofascism growing on the right which is absolutely terrifying and it is stronger than anything on the left at this particular moment. And the question is how will all this resolve. I think that there’s such a move, I think Donald Trump introduced such an attitude of authoritarianism and a disregard for institutions or for the laws and rules that had held society together for a while, even with…
I can’t disagree. I wonder if you have any thoughts about how we get out of it.
